findings.issue: Common noun תּוֹרַת (H8451, feminine singular construct) is dumped as the untranslated lemma torá; common nouns stay Spanish.
Common noun הַמִּנְחָה (H4503, definite feminine singular) is dumped as the untranslated lemma minjá; common nouns stay Spanish.
Hiphil infinitive absolute is smoothed as finite future acercarán; 3rd-person plural follows the masculine-plural subject בְּנֵי, while tense is not marked on the infinitive.

notes: Object, sons of Aaron, Jehová, and altar match the tokens; לפני is idiomatically delante de.
